YouTube Shorts.pacing: Fast cut frequency (every 2.5-4s), strong loop capability
bestPractices: First 2 seconds must visually demonstrate the thesis or payoff
Seamless loop ending dramatically elevates algorithmic push
Pinned first comment with clear discussion prompt

TikTok.pacing: Ultra-fast cuts, text overlay in center safe area, trending sound underbed
TikTok.primaryAudienceDriver: Completion rate and immediate Shares within first 1,000 impressions
bestPractices: Pattern interrupt in frame 1 (rapid zoom, movement, unexpected prop)
Conversational raw aesthetic often outperforms studio gloss
3 to 5 targeted niche hashtags rather than generic broad tags

Instagram Reels.pacing: High visual fidelity, aesthetic typography, strong emotional hook
Instagram Reels.primaryAudienceDriver: Saves and Direct Message Shares per 100 views
bestPractices: Include actionable takeaway that warrants tapping 'Save'
High-contrast aesthetic font that fits IG feed aesthetic
Use 5-8 descriptive hashtags and clear hook in caption line 1

YouTube Long-form.pacing: Narrative arc, structured chapters, retention peaks at chapter transitions
bestPractices: Thumbnail & title packaging account for 60% of reach
First 30 seconds must reaffirm the title promise without logo filler
Open loops every 2-3 minutes to prevent drop-off
